title: The Quarantine Breach
logline: A mysterious outbreak hits a deep-space station, and a corrupt doctor hires a pilot to smuggle them out while ignoring the dying masses.

roles.description: Terrified, coughing, abandoning their oath to survive.
Opportunistic, making a fortune selling fake clean bills of health.
A sealed orbital habitat, completely dark.
An automated supply train carrying vaccines.
A heavily armed navy blockade runner.
The ruthless authority enforcing the quarantine.

public_situation: The {role:quarantine_station} has been sealed off by the {role:border_patrol} after a highly contagious pathogen was detected.
private_truth: The doctor accidentally engineered the pathogen and is trying to buy a fake identity from the smuggler to flee before anyone finds out.

beats.public_change: The station broadcasts a desperate plea for medical supplies.

missions.reason: The doctor asks the pilot to scan the station's external vents to map the quarantine grid so they can fly their own skiff out.
missions.private_fact: The doctor is actually looking for a blind spot in the sensors to escape.

missions.reason: The pilot must dock at an airlock and collect a sealed case of blood samples.
missions.private_fact: The case is full of stolen credits to pay the smuggler.

beats.public_change: The smuggler begins broadcasting offers for guaranteed clean transit.

missions.reason: The smuggler pays the pilot to deliver forged quarantine-bypass credentials to the doctor.
missions.private_fact: The credentials will overload the airlock sensors, breaking the seal for everyone.

missions.reason: The smuggler needs the pilot to buy bulk medical parts and deliver them to the station.
missions.private_fact: The parts are actually components for a high-yield explosive to blow the docking bay doors.

beats.public_change: A medical convoy jumps into the system, carrying genuine vaccines.

missions.reason: The smuggler pays the pilot to destroy the vaccine convoy so their forged credentials remain valuable.
missions.private_fact: The convoy is completely unarmed and broadcasting on all channels.

beats.public_change: The doctor breaches the airlock and flees in their own light medical skiff, triggering the blockade alarms.

missions.reason: The smuggler pays the pilot to attack the patrol cruiser and create a distraction so the doctor's skiff can jump away.
missions.private_fact: The patrol cruiser hails the pilot, offering full amnesty if they destroy the doctor's skiff instead to protect the sector.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the cruiser and helps the doctor flee.
resolutions.summary: The doctor escapes into the wider galaxy, taking the pathogen with them. The station is doomed, and the smuggler gets rich.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot broke a medical blockade and let a plague ship loose in the sector.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the cruiser's offer and destroys the pod.
resolutions.summary: The doctor is vaporized, containing the threat. The station eventually receives aid, but the smuggler marks the pilot for death.
The patrol cruiser easily catches the doctor's pod and tows it back. The station remains locked down forever.

loose_threads.detail: The pathogen's genetic sequence includes a trademark signature from a major agricultural conglomerate.
The patrol cruiser was ordered to guard the station three days before the outbreak even began.

radio_hooks: Unconfirmed reports of new disease vector spreading through {system}.

voice_direction.panicked_doctor: Desperate, speaks too fast, lies effortlessly.
voice_direction.smuggler_baron: Calm, oily, treats human lives as a spreadsheet.
